collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Two lifelong friends want a yearly custom of their own: climb the mountain together, or share a meal at the same spot.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) have been friends since they could walk. Now that both of them have busy lives, they hardly see each other. (subject) suggests a promise: once a year, no matter what, they will spend a whole day together. The only question is what to do. What should their custom be?

choices.label: The Same Meal at the Same Spot

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Once a year, they climb the mountain together, complaining all the way up. At the top, they sit and talk about the year that has gone. As they get older, the climbs get slower. They never miss one.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Once a year, they meet at the rock by the lagoon and eat the same meal: grilled fish and breadfruit, exactly as they did as children. They tell each other everything. Nobody else is ever invited.
